items.title: The voice cast is announced
items.caption:
MLBB's very first anime-themed skins "The Aspirants" are now unveiled! Fanny and Layla's all-new skins will be featuring renowned CV Nana Mizuki and Yoshino Nanjo!

After the Skins are released, players can use the "Switch Voiceovers" feature exclusive to "The Aspirants" Skins and listen to the Skins' voiceovers in other languages. This feature can be directly accessed on the Skin Display screen. Let's enjoy interpretations brought by different voice actors!

In the new story, the new adventure, what lies ahead for Layla and Fanny? What stories will unfold between the two? Stay tuned and we will unveil them one by one! Meanwhile, let's look forward to the top-notch performance by the two voice actors!

The Aspirants Skins will be available in the game starting from January 22. Please share in the comments your expectations for the new skins!

The "Aspirants Unite" themed draw event will end on 11/04, seize your last chance! Guinevere "Daybreak Halo" and Vexana "Twilight Star" are waiting for you. Come get the skins you love!
Participate in the "Aspirants Unite" themed draw event! First 10X Draw using Diamonds is 50% OFF, and daily first 1X Draw using Diamonds is 50% OFF. Every 10 draws guarantees an EPIC or higher quality skin.
The "Aspirants Conquest" draw event will also end on 11/04. Get The Aspirants items through "Aspirants Conquest" draws! Daily first 1X Draw using Diamonds is 50% OFF, first 10X Draw using Diamonds is 30% OFF. Use The Aspirants items to personalize your gaming experience!

items.title: Photos of the new semester
items.caption:
The Aspirants have sent you photos of the new semester.
There are familiar faces, along with new changes.
But among them, there seem to be some never-before-seen figures.
Who could they be?

On 09/16, Ruby "Mecha Maiden" and Angela "Cyber Cherubin" will make a limited-time return.
The all-new [TheMLabel] will also launch on the same day. Let's explore the untold stories of The Aspirants!
As for the new figures... stay tuned!

items.title: TheMLabel is live
items.caption:
TheMLabel, a dedicated gallery for MLBB's signature skin series, is now live!
One Series, One Hall: Every top-tier series gets its own gallery, complete with exclusive visuals and theme music
Four Exclusive Perks: Complete a full series collection to unlock an exclusive poster and rewards (golden skin name, Animated Skin Tag, Collection Crest, and Showcase display)
Skin Story: Lore, Cinematic Trailers, and character designs all in one place
⏳ The Aspirants is the first series to be featured. See how much of the series you've already collected!

items.title: Become the hero of your own story
items.caption:
TheMLabel, a dedicated gallery for MLBB's signature skin series, launches on 09/16.
In the game, heroes are never confined to just one look. Different skins and colors help each hero become truly one of a kind.
Outside the game, we're no different. You don't have to fit into any label or be the "main character" in someone else's eyes.
Let your own colors shine, and become the hero of your own story!

items.title: Ruby and Angela return again
items.caption: From 09/16 to 10/08, Angela "Cyber Cherubin" and Ruby "Mecha Maiden" return for a limited time! Enjoy 50% OFF on your first 10X Draw and daily first 1X Draw! Don't miss out on the abundant rare items in the prize pool!

items.title: Free Pass, September 18
items.caption:
From 09/18 to 09/22, log in to the game to claim FREE Pass, and complete tasks to get more draw chances!
Use the Pass to participate in The Aspirants returning skin draw event for a chance to get Ruby "Mecha Maiden" and Angela "Cyber Cherubin"!
Aside from the skins, you may also obtain exclusive items from The Aspirants, such as Quick Chat and Graffiti, from your draws! Every ten draws guarantees one Epic or better skin! Don't miss out!

items.title: The Aspirants against the Enders
items.caption:
The Aspirants VS The Enders: the characters from the Enders faction make their debut.
New Aspirants series skins: Obsidia "Imperatrix Arashi" and Selena "Silverbolt Raiko" officially launch on 10/09!
What's the connection between them? What story awaits?
Stay tuned for more reveals to come!

items.title: Free Pass, September 25

Use the Pass to participate in The Aspirants returning skin draw event for a chance to get Ruby "Mecha Maiden" and Angela "Cyber Cherubin"!
Aside from the skins, you may also obtain exclusive items from The Aspirants like Quick Chat and other customization items from your draws! Don't miss out!

items.title: A Game of Storms: Obsidia's character bio
items.caption:
Obsidia "Imperatrix Arashi" Character Bio is now live! She cast a young Ender into the human world, just to wait for a truly spectacular betrayal. Was Selena's defiance a mere accident, or a move Obsidia had planned all along? Tap to read A Game of Storms and uncover the true endgame The Enders' Queen desires.
https://play.mobilelegends.com/lore/albumitem/295/1/en

items.title: Thunder's Gambit: Selena's character bio
items.caption:
Selena "Silverbolt Raiko" Character Bio is now live!
She carries the bloodline of the Enders, yet enjoys the freedom of "playing human."
When the recall order arrives, will Selena submit to the Mother Matrix, or pilot her "Thunderclouds" to carve out a path of her own?
Tap to read Thunder's Gambit and see how she unleashes a thunderstorm, striking her first blow against fate.
https://play.mobilelegends.com/lore/albumitem/296/1/en

items.title: The Skin Character Connection Hub
items.caption:
The Aspirants series has entered Phase Ⅴ. Can you untangle the connections among all 10 characters?
Who are friends? Who are rivals? Who created whom? And who betrayed whom?
The Skin Character Connection Hub is now live! For the first time, all 10 characters' connections are revealed in full. Tap any character to view their portrait, voice lines, and backstory!
But that's not all. Beyond the official lore, you can create relationships of your own!
Enter the Creator Center to arrange characters, connect them however you like, and define their relationships. Create your own relationship network for The Aspirants.
Don't forget to publish your relationship network and see how many likes it gets!

LINK: https://sg-play.mobilelegends.com/events/relationship
